content:
Anika Patel: Quick flag  I found mixed param names in examples: `response_format` vs `output_format`. This will confuse SDK users during migration.
Sam Chen: Ah, saw that too. Which one is the SDK surface?
Leo Martín: SDK accepts `response_format` (legacy). We added `output_format` as an alias in v0.9.0 to match runtime. Both work now but docs should present one canonical name.
Maya Singh: I prefer `output_format` — clearer for users. We can show `response_format` as deprecated alias.
Anika Patel: Plan: pick canonical `output_format`, update examples across REST + SDK, add migration snippet, and add a glossary entry for the alias. Also add a small deprecation callout.
Sam Chen: I'll add a meta redirect on the old page so links don't break and coordinate infra for a quick deploy.
Leo Martín: I'll open a tiny SDK PR to keep `response_format` as an alias and add a deprecation warning in the docstring + a unit test.
Anika Patel: Draft migration snippet: 
```
# old
resp = client.generate(model='x', response_format='json')
# new
resp = client.generate(model='x', output_format='json')
```
Maya Singh: Add a validate_json example for structured outputs: 
```
resp = client.generate(model='x', output_format='json', validate_json=True)
```
docs-bot: lint notice  docs/style: prefer `output_format` (rule: param-naming). Files flagged: docs/guides/generate.md: lines 42,89
Anika Patel: Assigning tasks: update examples (me), migration snippet (me), glossary entry (Maya), SDK alias PR (Leo), redirect + deploy (Sam). ETA: EOW for doc PRs, Wed for redirect.
Sam Chen: Confirmed, I'll schedule the redirect deploy for Wed staging.
Leo Martín: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/834 :eyes: will link here.
Maya Singh: I'll push glossary draft in ~1hr and ask for a quick review.
Anika Patel: Thanks all. I'll push docs PR shortly and tag reviewers. Closing thread when PRs are linked.
Sam Chen: :thumbsup:
docs-bot: deployment scheduled for 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC (staging), will run smoke tests.
